clips.title: The story
paras: In Silverpine, A Recipe For Death gathers reagents for the Forsaken's New Plague. Apothecary Renferrel sends bear hearts and spider blood from the Sepulcher to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

In Silverpine Forest, Apothecary Renferrel sees the danger facing Sylvanas's people. Arthas's legions press them, and remnants of humanity remain their foes. Conventional warfare offers little hope. The Forsaken seek a New Plague that can rot living humans and undead Scourge alike. Renferrel's field research found that arachnid venom from the Skittering Dark, joined with toxins in the hearts of native bears, makes a virulent foundation.

The collected organs and blood from Silverpine's wilderness go beneath the ruins of Lordaeron, to the Apothecarium in the Undercity. Master Apothecary Faranell oversees the Royal Apothecary Society's design. He takes Renferrel's samples to test their contaminable properties and refine formulas that may secure Forsaken supremacy across the continent.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Arthas's numbers are overwhelming. But with a New Plague we could eradicate both the Scourge Army and the Human infestation once and for all.

My studies have proven that spider blood combined with a toxin derived from a grizzled bear heart results in a deadly elixir. Collect samples from the spiders in the Skittering Dark to the northwest and from the bears wandering throughout Silverpine Forest. Deliver the reagents to Master Apothecary Faranell of the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hail, adventurer. What business do you have with the Royal Apothecary Society?

clips.title: Completion
paras: How good of Apothecary Renferrel to send you to me, friend. These samples will indeed prove useful to the cause. I will begin studying their toxic and contaminable properties at once.
